newsitem.title: USA: Jungle Street sets 1-for-4 resverse split.
newsitem.headline: Jungle Street sets 1-for-4 resverse split.

text.p: Jungle Street Inc said its board of directors has authorized a one-for-four reverse split of the company's common stock, effective today.
The stock split, announced late on Thursday, will leave the company with just over 3.66 million shares outstanding versus 14.64 million on a pre-split basis.
Jungle Street Inc is a holding company for shares of telecommunications company Televar Northwest Inc, an internet service provider in the Pacific Northwest.
